args.title: Fix duplicate detection for overlapping statements in dedupe.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The duplicate detection logic should account for overlapping days when statements are uploaded together. The current implementation only checks within a single upload's transactions and ignores potential overlaps when multiple batches for consecutive periods like months are uploaded in quick succession. Adjust the logic to account for keys in closely timed consecutive uploads.
